card.name: Words leading into catecholamine release
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'and' or 's' right before an expected catecholamine name (norepinephrine, epinephrine, catecholamines). Often follows 'release' or 'levels' and appears in stress-hormone or pheochromocytoma text.

modes.label: After release or levels
modes.description: The word 'of' after release or levels, ahead of norepinephrine or catecholamines.
modes.example: AdreView may increase release<< of>> norepinephrine from chromaff

modes.label: Stress-response phrasing
modes.description: Words in a phrase about the body's inflammatory and stress responses to insomnia.
modes.example: Insomnia can increase the body<<'s>> inflammatory and stress responses, said Fonar

modes.label: Between hormone names
modes.description: 'and' or 'and/or' joining a list of hormones or their breakdown products.
modes.example: levels of epinephrine<< and>> norepinephrine. Desfl

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word 'release' and away from 'binding' words.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before the text names a stress hormone like norepinephrine, usually in a phrase about its release.
